@graph.skos:note: Prose works that use literary styles and techniques to present factually accurate narratives in a compelling manner.
Works whose main purpose is to record and convey factual information.
Works whose main purpose is to convey knowledge, attitudes, and/or skills.
Documents in any form created or received by an agency, institution, organization, or individual, accumulated in the normal conduct of business or affairs.
Works that explain a religion, denomination, sect, etc., and defend it from external criticism.
Works that provide comprehensive instruction on doctrines and are often structured in question-and-answer form.
Concise authorized statements of religious doctrine within religions or denominations. For written statements that describe the goals, opinions, and policies of a person or group see [Manifestos.]

Biographies of saints, religious figures, and deities that focus on their lives as exemplars of the faith. For calendars or lists of martyrs that may contain some biographical information see [Martyrologies.]
Works that are considered sacred by a religion, denomination, sect, etc.
Official letters by a bishop, pastor, moderator, or chairperson to the members of his or her diocese or congregation within some Christian traditions.
Religious materials that are intended to be used as aids for private study, prayer, and reflection.
